title: atc-rest-api-gen options file
description: The settings of ApiGeneratorOptions.json, read by the atc-rest-api-gen CLI (the build reads the marker files).

$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file, for completion and validation in the editor.

validateSpecificationStrategy.description: OpenAPI specification validation strategy. Default: Strict.

includeDeprecated.description: Include deprecated operations and schemas in generated code. Default: false.

removeNamespaceGroupSeparatorInGlobalUsi.description: Remove blank lines between namespace groups in GlobalUsings.cs. Default: false (blank lines are preserved between groups).

overlays.description: OpenAPI Overlay files (1.0 to 1.2) applied to the specification first, in the order listed and before the --overlay files of the command line. Paths are relative to the options file. Default: none.

general.description: General settings shared across all generation modes.

projectStructure.description: Project structure type for code generation. Default: ThreeProjects (3 separate projects).

noCodingRules.description: Skip adding ATC coding rules updater files. Default: false (coding rules are added by default).

targetFramework.description: Target framework for generated projects. Default: Uses TargetFrameworkResult.RequiredTargetFramework.

hostProjectName.description: Override host project name (TwoProjects/ThreeProjects mode only). Default: null (auto-derived from base name).

contractsProjectName.description: Override contracts project name (SingleProject/ThreeProjects mode; TwoProjects keeps the contracts in the domain project). Default: null (auto-derived from base name).

domainProjectName.description: Override domain project name (TwoProjects/ThreeProjects mode only). Default: null (auto-derived from base name).

clientProjectName.description: Override client project name. Default: null (auto-derived from base name).

hostNamespace.description: Override host namespace (for generated code). Default: null (auto-derived from project name).

contractsNamespace.description: Override contracts namespace (written to marker file). Default: null (auto-derived from project name).

domainNamespace.description: Override domain namespace (written to marker file). Default: null (auto-derived from project name).

clientNamespace.description: Override client namespace (written to marker file). Default: null (auto-derived from project name).

hostUi.description: API documentation UI provider. Default: Scalar.

hostUiMode.description: Controls when the API documentation UI is enabled. Default: DevelopmentOnly.

aspire.description: Create an Aspire AppHost project for orchestration. Default: false.

namespace.description: Custom namespace prefix (null = auto-detect from project name). Default: null.

subFolderStrategy.description: Sub-folder organization strategy for generated types. Default: FirstPathSegment.

useMinimalApiPackage.description: Controls Atc.Rest.MinimalApi package integration. Default: Auto (auto-detect package reference).

useValidationFilter.description: Controls ValidationFilter generation for endpoints with parameters. Default: Auto.

useGlobalErrorHandler.description: Controls GlobalErrorHandlingMiddleware setup generation. Default: Auto.

versioningStrategy.description: API versioning strategy. Default: None (no versioning).

defaultApiVersion.description: Default API version when versioning is enabled. Format: "major.minor" (e.g., "1.0", "2.0"). Default: "1.0".

versionQueryParameterName.description: Query parameter name for QueryString versioning strategy. Default: "api-version".

versionHeaderName.description: HTTP header name for Header versioning strategy. Default: "X-Api-Version".

versionRouteSegmentTemplate.description: Route segment template for UrlSegment versioning strategy. Default: "v{version:apiVersion}".

reportApiVersions.description: Report supported API versions in response headers (api-supported-versions, api-deprecated-versions). Default: true.

assumeDefaultVersionWhenUnspecified.description: Assume default API version when client doesn't specify. Applies to QueryString and Header strategies only. Default: true.

generateHandlersOutput.description: Output folder for generated handler files, relative to the project root. Default: "ApiHandlers".

subFolderStrategy.description: Sub-folder organization strategy for handlers. Default: None.

stubImplementation.description: Stub implementation type for generated handlers. Options: "throw-not-implemented", "error-501", "default-value". Default: "throw-not-implemented".

server.description: Server-side code generation settings (contracts, endpoints, handlers).

namespace.description: Custom namespace prefix (null = auto-detect from project name). Default: null.

clientSuffix.description: HTTP client class name suffix. Default: "Client".

clientGranularity.description: Client granularity: one client per API area, or a single client covering all operations. Default: PerArea.

clientName.description: Explicit client type name, used verbatim. Only meaningful when ClientGranularity is Single. Default: null (derived from the namespace).

generateOAuthTokenManagement.description: Generate OAuth2 token provider, handler, and DI extensions when OAuth2 security is detected in OpenAPI spec. Default: true.

extensibleEnums.description: Generate string enums as extensible enums: a value the specification does not list is kept instead of failing the response. False gives C# enums. Default: true.

client.description: Client-side code generation settings (HTTP client, models).
